pages.text: ProjectE priced it at exactly nine diamonds. The market held.

pages.title: The Reviewed Table
pages.text: $(thing)Uranium Ingot$() — 73,728 EMC, nine diamonds on the nose. $(thing)Uranium Nugget$() — 8,192 EMC, exact parity with Aeternalis Fuel. Blocks and nuggets compress and split ninefold, so the ledger balances in every direction.$(p)Every value here is priced as an exchange, never a printer. The dupe audit says so in writing.

pages.title: Collector Fuel
pages.text: Energy Collectors accept uranium in all three sizes — nugget, ingot, and block — as legitimate fuel. With the nugget sitting at exact Aeternalis parity, the collector chain trades fuel for fuel, one to one: Danger's ore joins ProjectE's fuel ladder at the top rung without bending it.$(p)Yes, that means a wall of collectors quietly running on $(l:orespawn_integrations:ores_gems/uranium)Uranium$(). It was always going to.

pages.title: EMC Hygiene
pages.text: $(l:orespawn_integrations:always_uranium/bottled_uranium)Bottled Uranium$() and the $(l:orespawn_integrations:always_uranium/dirty_arc_reactor)Dirty Arc Reactor$() are pinned EMC-free on purpose. Both craft from EMC-bearing uranium, so without the pin the condenser would quietly become a triple-buff brewery and a reactor mint. It doesn't, and it never will. You're welcome.

pages.title: The Warthog
pages.text: This thread's endgame is literally a warthog. An additive MCHeli content pack fields a depleted-uranium-belt $(thing)A-10$() whose GAU-8 resupplies with uranium ingots — and MCHeli matches ammo by path, not namespace, so Danger's uranium and HBM's uranium both feed the belt. Stock aircraft untouched.$(p)There's a hidden advancement in it: $(thing)Warthog Diet$(). Consider this a standing invitation.

pages.title: Further Reading
pages.text: Survival crafting for the A-10 itself lives in $(l:orespawn_integrations:world_remembers/air_cavalry)Air Cavalry$(), and the crusher math for uranium ore in $(l:orespawn_integrations:world_remembers/rail_works)Rail Works$().$(p)The whole chapter answers to the $(thing)threads.uranium$() switch in the config — flip it, reload, and every recipe here politely steps aside.
